title: Time for Self-promotion. What are you building this Monday?

selftext:

comments.author: trilient1
comments.body:
https://preview.redd.it/iqy8le35jipg1.png?width=1598&format=png&auto=webp&s=c847349cc4c9b0783097518813200dbcd2bb65ce

I'm building my own custom game engine. I've been a hobbyist game developer for years, primarily working with Unreal Engine. This project started as a means to give me deeper knowledge of how game engines work, being able to build the engine and make adjustments and see those engine changes live is great. And it's been fun to figure out how to use AI.

comments.author: kujasgoldmine
comments.body:
https://preview.redd.it/4akrkzhxnipg1.jpeg?width=2560&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=dd2366a3abc826130a6687d58ad290c576087dc9

I'm building a minigame for my unnamed roguelike that is like a mix between Vampire survivors, Binding of Isaac an Darkest Dungeon. Fully voice acted. In it, player can sometimes find invites to a card game against Fate itself, where player picks one card which gets flipped over. It has hundreds of different outcomes. Good cards or cursed cards of different rarities.

One of my favourites so far is a celestial quality (Highest item quality) cursed card that just kicks player to main menu in a funny comical way, dubbed The End. Like 1 in 5000 chance to get it. But it unlocks something special for future runs and alters the main menu. Another funny example is Death card, a legendary cursed card, also extremely rare. There's a twist in it though. >!Game will not end right there, but Death itself spawns in game and chases player. Currently the design is that if it catches up, it's still not game over, but you get to instead throw a dice, like in Talisman! Could be instant death or something entirely else. !<

Also working on a disbelieve minigame for it that consists of different smaller minigames, allowing player to do their best to not believe. It can be pretty easy, as player is a goblin. "Me no believe in fate!". But the button gets more corrupted the more fates are not believed, which can end up badly as it's related to the world evil.

comments.author: spacespacespapce
comments.body:
I couldn't model well and needed 3d assets for my game. So I built a multi-agent [system](https://nativeblend.app) that learns from tutorials and builds models for you in Blender. All from the command line.

Example: `nativeblend build "a car" --style "low-poly"`

https://i.redd.it/ywnz7mq4nmpg1.gif
